unresolved.finding: This file incorporates GPL version 3 and requires accompanying GPL text but contains only the LGPL supplement and provides no location for the incorporated GPL document.
The supplied license text is version 3 while README explicitly offers version 2.1 or later, leaving the version-2.1 option undocumented here despite version 3 being a permitted later choice.
The explicit LGPL-2.1-or-later grant conflicts with the unqualified public-domain statement in doc/man/copying.texinfo, without explaining a difference in applicability.
The claim of validation with standard parameter settings supplies no case identifiers, settings, revision, or specific report reference to establish its coverage.
The midnight synchronization schedule lacks a timezone and the promised near-future migration lacks a date, leaving the currency of the repository-authority instructions unclear.
The first-chapter heading fallback explicitly fails when a color or link mark intervenes after the contents, potentially leaving incorrect running headings.
When pdfescapestring is unavailable, txiescapepdf silently performs no escaping despite accepting destination and outline strings containing PDF special characters.
pdfurl interpolates the URL directly into a PDF literal string without escaping parentheses or backslashes, so otherwise valid URL text can produce a malformed or altered link target.
Each invocation of fonttextsize 10 halves the current paragraph spacing globally, so repeated size selection progressively changes layout instead of setting a stable size configuration.
reducedfonts assigns reducedcaps instead of smallcaps, leaving sc text at the previously selected small-cap size inside reduced text.
Every oddfooting or everyfooting assignment subtracts another 12pt from pageheight and vsize without tracking an existing footer reservation.
Alphabetic enumeration checks itemno against zero instead of checking its case-code mapping, so advancing beyond z or Z bypasses the intended exhaustion error and emits inappropriate characters.
Multitable column widths, column count, and fraction mode are global and not saved across nested tables, allowing an inner table to corrupt the outer table's subsequent columns.
novalidate suppresses stream initialization but leaves synindex closing undefined index streams, TOC creation outside the links guard, and float metadata writes to an unopened auxiliary stream.
The macro argument limit uses character comparison if rather than numeric ifnum, making the intended greater-than-256 check ineffective.
The if#1; sentinel tests compare the first two characters of multi-character parameter names, so names beginning with repeated letters such as aa can prematurely terminate parameter processing.
PDF cross-references strip interior spaces from external filenames but retain surrounding spaces in node targets, producing destinations that can disagree with the intended file or node.
crossmanualxref identifies Top by rendered width rather than text equality, and adding the same 7sp to both boxes does not prevent equal-width non-Top names from losing their section label.
setupdatafile defines but never invokes its loop for resetting bytes 128–255, and the surrounding group would discard those local catcode changes even if the loop were invoked there.
The image entry point rejects all images when epsfbox is unavailable even in PDF mode, whose dopdfimage path does not use epsfbox.
Selecting a Latin encoding overwrites active UTF-8 lead-byte definitions, while subsequently selecting UTF-8 only installs character mappings and does not restore those byte decoders.
The four-byte UTF-8 initialization stops before lead byte F4, leaving valid sequences for the highest Unicode plane without the four-byte decoder.
The UTF-8 mapping omits scientific characters such as ±, µ, ×, and ÷ that the Latin-1 mapping supports, and undefined characters are dropped from output with only a log message.
The mappings for U+0162 and U+0163 swap uppercase and lowercase T with cedilla.
U+2192 RIGHTWARDS ARROW is mapped to expansion, which renders mapsto rather than the right arrow provided by arrow.
afourwide is described as landscape but configures a 297mm-high by 210mm-wide portrait page.
The .url file contains only a bare address instead of the InternetShortcut section and URL key used by Windows shortcuts and by trunk/xbeach.url.
The included copying fragment sets the output filename to copying.info, conflicting with its parent manual's xbeach.info setting.
The copying section declares the software public domain without identifying an applicable dedication or reconciling this blanket statement with the separately licensed bundled components.
The manual hard-codes version 0.1.0 instead of obtaining the version from the build, so its advertised version can diverge from the documented executable.
The translation permission refers to approval by the Foundation without identifying that organization anywhere in this manual.
The GNU program attribution and index entries for greetings and tail recursion appear to be unrelated template residue in the XBeach manual.
The invocation instructions name params.txt but omit where it is resolved and how to supply its required contents, leaving the documented command insufficient to reproduce a run.
Bug-report instructions require xbeach --version although the invocation section documents no options or version-query behavior, leaving this command's support unestablished by the manual.
